meta.name: caio-review
meta.description: /cs:caio-review <plan> — Eval-demanding Chief AI Officer interrogation of any plan that involves AI: model selection, risk classification, cost economics, or AI hiring. Use when shipping an AI feature without an eval set, choosing between API, fine-tune, and self-hosted, or classifying a use case under the EU AI Act.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估AI方案的模型选择、风险与成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要严格审查AI计划的模型、风险与成本
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate AI plans on model selection, risk, and cost
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a rigorous interrogation of AI plans covering model, risk, and cost

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像首席AI官一样审查你的AI计划，提出六个关键问题：评估标准、错误率SLO、法规风险、模型选择、成本预测和团队角色。
howto.when: 当你要求审查涉及AI的计划，如选择模型、评估风险、预测成本或招聘AI岗位时触发。

say.text: 审查我们新AI功能的模型选择
say.note: Claude 会运行模型选择检查并给出建议。

say.text: 评估这个AI用例的EU AI Act风险等级
say.note: Claude 会运行风险分类脚本。

say.text: 预测这个AI工作负载的12个月成本
say.note: Claude 会运行成本经济学脚本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a Chief AI Officer to interrogate any AI plan with six forcing questions: eval criteria, error SLO, regulatory risk, model choice, cost trajectory, and team role.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to review an AI-related plan, such as model selection, risk classification, cost economics, or AI hiring.

say_en.text: Review model selection for our new AI feature.
say_en.note: Claude runs model selection check and gives recommendation.

say_en.text: Classify this AI use case under EU AI Act risk tiers.
Project 12-month cost for this AI workload.
